sunken.$description: Wells inside a surface: input fills on canvas, table headers, code blocks, track of a toggle or progress bar. One tone step below canvas.

page.$description: Page background. AppShell body. Everything else sits on it.

default.$description: Card, panel, table, form section: the default container. One tone step above canvas, always paired with --apui-border-muted.

raised.$description: A container that sits on another container (a card inside a panel, a selected tab, popover trigger). One step above default.

overlay.$description: Dialog, DropdownMenu, Toast, DatePicker popover, Select listbox. Always with --apui-elevation-overlay.

glass.$description: Opt-in glass surface for Card, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Toast, Navbar, Alert. Use with backdrop-filter: blur(var(--glass-blur)) saturate(var(--glass-saturate)), --apui-surface-glass-border and --apui-elevation-glass. 80% opacity is the floor that keeps text 9:1 and --apui-text-muted-glass 4.5:1 over a pure black, white, red or blue backdrop. Falls back to --apui-surface-raised under prefers-reduced-transparency or without backdrop-filter. Opaque in high-contrast.

inverse.$description: Tooltip, inverse Toast, a dark band in a light page.

glass-border.$description: Edge of a glass surface. A light rim in both themes so the pane reads over busy backdrops.

default.$description: Primary text and icons on every surface. 12:1 or better in light and dark.

muted.$description: Secondary text: hints, captions, labels in tables, placeholder text. 4.5:1 or better on every surface, sunken included.

subtle.$description: Non-text only: decorative icons, chart gridline labels at 3:1, separators drawn as text. Never for information a person needs to read.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls. Exempt from contrast minimums (WCAG 1.4.3), so never the only signal; pair with aria-disabled and cursor.

muted-glass.$description: Secondary text on --apui-surface-glass. One step stronger than --apui-text-muted in light, so it holds 4.5:1 over any backdrop.

muted.$description: The hairline every container carries (Strata + edges): cards, panels, table dividers, menu separators. Decorative; set to transparent for pure tonal layering. Becomes a 3:1+ line in high-contrast.

default.$description: Outline of interactive controls: Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Radio, outline Button. 3:1 or better on every surface (WCAG 1.4.11).

strong.$description: Hover outline on controls, selected row edge, active tab underline.

soft-edge-width.$description: Edge drawn around soft-tinted status surfaces (soft Badge, soft Alert) so the tint is not the only boundary. 0 in light and dark, where the spec draws none; 1px in high-contrast, where the fill alone sits too close to the page. Paint it with the tone border color.

color.$description: Focus ring color: 3:1 or better against every surface. Drawn as a 2px ring outside a 2px gap of --apui-focus-ring-offset-color.

offset-color.$description: The gap between a control and its focus ring. Reassign to the surface a control sits on when it is not --apui-surface-default.

hover.$description: Hover wash for ghost buttons, menu items, table rows. Layered over the surface, so it works on any surface or tint.

bg.$description: Selected table row, selected menu item, current nav item, chosen date.

border.$description: Edge of a selected item when it needs one (selected card, chosen radio card).

1.$description: Categorical series 1 (steel). Assign in this fixed order, never cycled; a 7th series folds into Other. Validated for colorblind separation on adjacent pairs (deltaE 28 light, 12 dark). Light slots 2, 4 and 6 sit under 3:1, so charts always ship hover tooltips and a table view.

grid.$description: Gridlines and baselines. Recessive by design.

keyword.$description: Code: if, return, const, class. 4.5:1 or better on --apui-surface-sunken in every theme.

string.$description: Code: String literals. 4.5:1 or better on --apui-surface-sunken in every theme.

number.$description: Code: Numbers and booleans. 4.5:1 or better on --apui-surface-sunken in every theme.

function.$description: Code: Function and method names. 4.5:1 or better on --apui-surface-sunken in every theme.

property.$description: Code: Properties, attributes, keys. 4.5:1 or better on --apui-surface-sunken in every theme.

comment.$description: Code: Comments, set in italic. 4.5:1 or better on --apui-surface-sunken in every theme.

primary.$description: Main action and brand. One solid primary per view. Fill of the solid variant (Button, Badge, Toggle on, Checkbox checked when primary).

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-primary. 4.5:1 or better.

primary-soft.$description: Fill of the soft variant: soft Button, Badge, Alert, status tints, category fills (Stat, calendar events).

primary-soft-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-primary-soft. 4.5:1 or better.

primary-border.$description: Outline variant border, soft Badge border in high-contrast. 3:1 or better on every surface.

primary-text.$description: Text in the outline, ghost and link variants, and colored values (deltas, status text). 4.5:1 or better on every surface.

secondary.$description: Secondary actions that still need weight. Slate by default so it never competes with primary. Fill of the solid variant (Button, Badge, Toggle on, Checkbox checked when primary).

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-secondary. 4.5:1 or better.

secondary-soft.$description: Fill of the soft variant: soft Button, Badge, Alert, status tints, category fills (Stat, calendar events).

secondary-soft-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-secondary-soft. 4.5:1 or better.

secondary-border.$description: Outline variant border, soft Badge border in high-contrast. 3:1 or better on every surface.

secondary-text.$description: Text in the outline, ghost and link variants, and colored values (deltas, status text). 4.5:1 or better on every surface.

accent.$description: Emphasis by exception: the one highlighted bar, row or stat. Not for actions. Fill of the solid variant (Button, Badge, Toggle on, Checkbox checked when primary). Below 3:1 against canvas in light, so solid accent and warning carry a 1px edge in their -edge color.

accent-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-accent. 4.5:1 or better.

accent-soft.$description: Fill of the soft variant: soft Button, Badge, Alert, status tints, category fills (Stat, calendar events).

accent-text.$description: Text in the outline, ghost and link variants, and colored values (deltas, status text). 4.5:1 or better on every surface.

neutral-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-neutral. 4.5:1 or better.

neutral-text.$description: Text in the outline, ghost and link variants, and colored values (deltas, status text). 4.5:1 or better on every surface.

warning-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-warning. 4.5:1 or better.

error-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-error. 4.5:1 or better.

info-foreground.$description: Text and icons on --apui-color-info. 4.5:1 or better.

overlay.$description: Dialog, DropdownMenu, Toast, popovers. High-contrast relies on edges instead.

glass.$description: Glass panes, so they lift off the backdrop they blur.

raised.$description: Raised surfaces in Strata use tone, not shadow. The Harbor preset sets this to a soft shadow.
